name: Divine Smite

header.Casting Time: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a target with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

casting.casting_time: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a target with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike

authored_intent: Bonus Action immediately after own melee weapon/Unarmed Strike hit; add Radiant damage to that hit, +1d8 versus Fiend/Undead; higher slots add 1d8; once-only hit/cost receipt.

rules.text: The target takes an extra 2d8 Radiant damage from the attack.
The damage increases by 1d8 if the target is a Fiend or an Undead.
The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 1.
